caption: The drawing depicts a single brown jug centered on a plain, off-white background. The jug has a rounded, bulbous body and a short, narrow neck ending in a small, upward-flaring rim. A cylindrical tan cork stopper is fitted into the opening at the top. The jug features a single curved handle attached from the neck to the upper side of the body on the right. The jug's surface is a uniform dark brown with areas of lighter brown highlighting to suggest reflected light and curvature. There is a small inscription in red near the handle that reads "MAR.5" and a small red star above it. At the top right corner of the drawing, there is some handwritten text indicating descriptive details about the object as a "Rum Jug" along with measurements. There are no additional objects or details within the drawing.
title: Stone Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
